question: What appearance and disruptive power are associated with the molten-gold form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is a cause of agitating cities and similar effects.
Appearance and function are linked in this form.
inference: The molten-gold form radiates like heated gold and causes agitation of cities and the like.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of agitating cities and so forth.
